text:
maria: Dropping a quick thread for tomorrow's sync — propose a compact 'notification rollup' in the alert preview that groups channels by medium and shows a tiny timeline for active quiet windows. Goal: keep the preview short and scannable. Mock: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/rollup-proto.png

anil: Nice direction. Accessibility must be first-class here: the rollup should expose a clear reading order, aria roles, and non-color indicators for overlaps. Suggested SR announce: "Notification rollup, N groups. Use left/right to navigate groups."

lisa: Copy callout: instead of technical terms use friendly language — header: "Quiet schedule"; pill: "2 channels quiet"; helper: "Temporarily pause notifications for these channels." Keep tooltip copy concise.

devin: Backend note: rendering per-channel segments can be heavy. Propose the API return grouped windows: `groups: [{medium: 'Pager', count: 1, windows: [{start,end,source}]}]`. If nested is painful we can return flattened rows but include counts.

emily: Interaction thought: hover (desktop) should expand a micro-list of channels; on mobile the pill should open a bottom sheet. Avoid hover-only discoverability.

jake: Keyboard pattern idea: treat the rollup as a list (role=list) and groups as listitems with aria-posinset/aria-setsize. Left/right to move focus, Enter to open edit, Escape to close. And when the active item changes announce e.g. "Pager group, 1 quiet window from 10:00 to 10:30 (auto)" via a polite live region.

anil: Contrast note: pastel fills in the mock fail AA on small widths. Consider stronger fills and a patterned texture or border for overlapping segments. Also ensure focus outlines meet contrast thresholds.

lisa: UX nit: show an "auto" micro-badge when a quiet window was system-generated, with tooltip: "Auto-snooze (policy). Click to view policy details." Users frequently ask why things silenced themselves.

devin: Performance edge-case: if a policy creates many overlapping windows across groups, we should coalesce by contiguous time ranges per group to avoid rendering dozens of tiny segments. I'll add a coalescing step server-side.

emily: Visual affordance: when groups are collapsed, show the top two channel avatars then a +N chip so users get a quick sense of which channels are included. Tap expands to a full list in the sheet.

maria: Action items: 1) maria to iterate mock with collapsed avatars + patterned overlap treatment 2) anil to write a11y micro-spec with SR strings and focus mapping 3) lisa to finalize copy strings and tooltips 4) devin to propose API coalescing shape and groupedCounts flag 5) jake to author keyboard nav doc and live-region phrasing 6) emily to mock mobile sheet + micro-list hover. I'll upload updated art before noon.
design-bot: Mock v1 uploaded: https://img.redwood.internal/ux/rollup-proto-v1.png
jake: Small accessibility PS — ensure the micro-list items are accessible and tappable even when the rollup is compressed (hit target >=44px). Also prefer explicit "View channels" affordance over tiny hover-only reveals.
tara: Copy parity: change any existing "Mute" labels to "Quiet" in the preview to reduce mixed terminology.
maria: Good catch, tara. We'll publish a short migration doc for labels and update existing preview instances. Thanks all — please DM me if you see blockers before sync. :)
